outcome: Umbilical cord blood hematological parameters (WBC, RBC, HGB, HCT, MCV, MCH, MCHC, PLT, LYM, MXD, NEU, RDW, PDW, MPV)
cohort: Healthy, term newborns (37-42 weeks) with normal birth weight born to apparently healthy pregnant mothers
finding: This study established reference intervals for umbilical cord blood hematological parameters in healthy newborns in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia, finding significant differences in some parameters based on mode of delivery.
mod_finding: Newborns delivered via cesarean section had lower WBC, RBC, and absolute neutrophil counts compared to those delivered spontaneously.
